ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive sound is less appealing right now than the layered heaviness of my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: BLEEDING, THE UNCENSORED Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggressive metal direction interests me, but I would prioritize closer matches to my recent Tool listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its mix of heavy riffs and melodic passages given my interest in In Flames and heavier rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness fits some of my listening, but I am more interested in intricate rhythms this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its forceful riffs and unpredictable rhythms alongside my recent heavier albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sing The Sorrow; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its darker melodic rock appeals, but it is a lower priority than the progressive choices today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intricate metal riffs fit my interests, but I would save this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Thirteenth Step; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its atmospheric, layered rock after listening to 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Getting Away With Murder; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The direct hard rock hooks fit my Hoobastank listening, but I want something more expansive right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes another Tool album with intricate rhythms and extended songs my strongest choice.
